verified_sources.title: OpenVINS ZUPT derivation
verified_sources.conclusion: Separate stationarity detection from synthetic measurement; dynamic objects and constant-velocity false detections need gating.

verified_sources.title: OpenVINS UpdaterZeroVelocity.cpp
verified_sources.conclusion: Public implementation; ours does not use its IMU residual or claim equivalence to an inertial EKF.

verified_sources.title: robot_localization sensor configuration
verified_sources.conclusion: Fuse independent observations, avoid duplicate wheel-derived pose and velocity; documented zero lateral velocity is a nonholonomic constraint, not automatic sonar stall detection.

verified_sources.title: Helmick et al. Slip-compensated path following, Advanced Robotics 2006
verified_sources.conclusion: Compare visual/inertial and wheel-kinematic estimates with their uncertainty; our calibrated commands are not measured wheel encoders.

verified_sources.title: Kobuki safety controller
verified_sources.conclusion: Bumper/cliff/wheel-drop events drive safety actions. Bumper contact is unavailable under our observation contract and must not be substituted by simulator contact.

verified_sources.title: Kilic et al. Slip-Based Autonomous ZUPT, RA-L 2021
verified_sources.conclusion: Predict slip and schedule stops for wheel-inertial ZUPT. Does not establish single-sonar stationarity thresholds.

verified_sources.title: Zhang et al. 2DLIW-SLAM, 2024
verified_sources.conclusion: LiDAR line constraints plus wheel and inertial observations address geometric degeneracy. Full scans/IMU exceed our input boundary.

verified_sources.title: Jia et al. Generative Spatial-Temporal Ultrasonic Odometry, 2024
verified_sources.conclusion: Uses overlapping sensor array and temporal window; one forward scalar range cannot reproduce array odometry. Code/results not independently verified.
